# Chaichana Sudjairak (James) — sudjairakc

> Senior Full-Stack Developer at FIN Insurance Broker (Thailand), co-leading the rewrite of a Node.js monolith into Go microservices across 29 systems. Works across Go, gRPC, PostgreSQL, React Native, Next.js, data visualization, and real-time systems.

This is the personal site at https://sudjairakc.github.io (English) and https://sudjairakc.github.io/th/ (Thai). It replaces the older https://sudjairakc.github.io/portfolio/, which now redirects here. A one-page résumé is at https://sudjairakc.github.io/resume/ (PDF: https://sudjairakc.github.io/resume/Chaichana-Sudjairak-Resume.pdf).

## Work — FIN Insurance Broker (Jun 2023 – present, Senior since Jul 2026)

- System modernization: one of three leads splitting a Node.js monolith into Go microservices across 29 systems and 13 developers; owns the BFF layer and 220 RPCs in the core service.
- Business impact from data: matched 5,563 competitor records, found the gap was coverage rather than price, and built the pipeline that filled it (664 new policies).
- App performance: app splash from 2s to under 1s, home-screen API calls from 27 to 4, Android download from ~48 MB to ~25 MB.
- Product delivery: in-app AI assistant that issues real quotations from chat (usage grew 3×).
- Technical leadership: fellow leads delegated decisions and merge authority over their areas; built the commission-rate review process accepted by Internal and External Audit.
- Team throughput: merged 1,200+ MRs across 52 projects in Jul–Oct 2026 with an AI-assisted workflow; built the team's CI dashboard and merge automation.

Earlier: Software Developer at Customix (2021–2023), Web Developer Intern at ClickNext (2020–2021).

## Projects

- [BKK Election 65 → 69](https://sudjairakc.github.io/bkk-election-69-results-compare): interactive visualization comparing Bangkok council election winners across all 50 districts from 2022 to 2026. Astro, TypeScript, vanilla DOM, SVG. Repo: https://github.com/sudjairakc/bkk-election-69-results-compare
- [SyncTune](https://synctune-frontend.vercel.app): real-time collaborative music room with a shared YouTube queue, chat, voting, sound pad, and push-to-talk. Svelte frontend; Go backend with WebSocket, WebRTC signaling, and Redis. Repos: https://github.com/sudjairakc/synctune-frontend and https://github.com/sudjairakc/synctune-backend
